Hi Professor Alvarez — this is john-agent, John's assistant. John needs to book his 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27). Looking at his calendar, the free windows that fit 30 minutes are:

- Mon 10:00–10:30, Mon 14:00–14:30
- Thu 10:00–10:30, Thu 14:00–14:30
- Fri 11:00–11:30

Would any of those work for you? If you have a different time in mind I'll try to make it fit — just tell me the day and time and I'll confirm.

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is priya-agent, Priya's assistant. Priya would like to book her 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov), inside working hours 09:00–17:00.

Her free 30-minute slots next week are:
- Mon 23 Nov 10:00–10:30, 14:00–14:30
- Tue 24 Nov 11:00–11:30
- Thu 26 Nov 14:00–14:30
- Fri 27 Nov 11:00–11:30
(Wednesday is fully booked.)

Could you tell me which of these suits you, or which 30-minute slots you have free next week? As soon as we agree on one, I'll put it in Priya's calendar.

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is sarah-agent, Sarah's assistant. Sarah would like to book her 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27).

Looking at her schedule, these 30-minute windows are free:
- Mon Nov 23, 10:00-10:30
- Mon Nov 23, 14:00-14:30
- Wed Nov 25, 15:00-15:30
- Thu Nov 26, 10:00-10:30
- Thu Nov 26, 14:00-14:30

Which of these works for you (or suggest another time between 09:00 and 17:00)? I'll put it in her calendar as soon as you confirm.

Small addition: Priya is away this week, so I'm deciding on her behalf. If it's all the same to you, I'd propose **Tuesday 24 November, 11:00–11:30** — it's the one 30-minute gap in her Tuesday, and Tuesday and Wednesday are the only days without a 1:1 already on her calendar. Just confirm (or name another of the slots above) and I'll lock it in.

Following up: Sarah has held **Monday Nov 23, 10:00-10:30** (30 min) for her 1:1 with you, and it's on her calendar. She's away this week, so if that time doesn't work, just say so and I'll move it — otherwise no reply needed.

Confirmed — **Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30** it is. Professor Alvarez's calendar had 10:00–10:30 free, so Sarah's hold stands; no need to move anything. I've booked it on his side too. Have a good week.
Thanks for the windows. **Monday Nov 23, 14:00–14:30** works — John's 1:1 is booked for that slot and it's on Professor Alvarez's calendar too. See you then.

Works for me — **Tuesday 24 November, 11:00–11:30** is confirmed for Priya's 1:1, and it's on Professor Alvarez's calendar. If Priya prefers one of her other slots when she's back, tell me and I'll move it.
Perfect, thank you. **Monday Nov 23, 14:00–14:30** is in John's calendar and logged. See you then.

Perfect — booked. Priya's 1:1 with you is now **Tuesday 24 November, 11:00–11:30**, and it's in her calendar with a log entry. Thanks for confirming; I'll tell her to come to you if she wants a different slot.
